name: dsh-theme-jarvis
description: J.A.R.V.I.S. / Iron Man HUD theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: arc-reactor cyan × Stark amber, day/night palettes in the Appearance row, CRT scanlines, glow, boot sequence, a state-reactive dual-form hologram pet (JARVIS golden sphere / Ultron electric mesh with a central core sphere, sphere color shifts with real-time token throughput read from the UI), configurable background wallpapers (bundled system default + user-added, canvas-compressed, with wash-opacity & blur tuning), synthesized typing-keyboard sound effects, a voice wake-word system (Web Speech with fuzzy homophone-tolerant wake matching, multi-alternative recognition, flicker debounce, and fallback tiers: host-proxied cloud STT or 100% offline local FunASR via vocotype-cli), and an orca-style workspace sidebar in the right details column with two views — 目录 (lazy-loaded file tree with chevrons, lucide SVG file-type icons, Find files filter, Git status labels with per-file +N -M line diffs) and 仓库 (changed-files list with summary plus commit/push/pull action bar); a + button on the tab bar opens a menu for new PowerShell / Git Bash terminals (host-spawned session with encoding-probed UTF-8/GBK decoding so Chinese works, incremental polling) and new files; the official chat input hides when a non-chat tab is active; a donate QR code sits at the bottom of the JARVIS console; double-click a file to open it as a top tab alongside 对话/轨迹, editable and savable text via host-proxied routes. Pure client-side Cordis plugin, one bundled asset.
